# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.5 Part B3 (Slot 67=heg): 12-Major AI Strategic Ecology & Dynamic Anti-Hegemon Layer (oe_mai_ / oe_heg_ai_). Generated by gen_majors_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# ==============================================================================
# Slot 67 (heg): O(1) Monthly Global Hegemon Cache (zero any_country loops!)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope: record current country as cached hegemon (theater, size, entropy window, tag ID).
oe_heg_ai_record_this = {
    save_scope_as = oe_heg_ai_cand
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_target value = scope:oe_heg_ai_cand }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_size value = num_locations }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_heg_ai_in_theater_1 = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_theater value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_heg_ai_in_theater_2 = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_theater value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_heg_ai_in_theater_3 = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_theater value = 3 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_theater value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { oe_rule_is_empire_entropy_lite = yes }
            has_variable = oe_ent_index
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } var:oe_ent_index >= 60 }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_ent_high value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_ent_high value = 0 }
    }
        if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = ROM } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = TUR } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = CHI } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = GLH } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 5 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = MOS } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = RUS } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 7 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = FRA } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 8 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = HAB } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 9 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = CAS } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 10 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = SPA } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 11 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = MAM } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 12 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = POL } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 13 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = PLC } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 14 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = TIM } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 15 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = IRA } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 16 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = DLH } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 17 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = VIJ } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 18 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = ENG } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 19 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = GBR } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 20 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = MUG } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 21 } }
        else_if = { limit = { tag = BAH } set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 22 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 99 } }
}

# Country scope: evaluate current country against the monthly best hegemon score.
oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_heg_ai_meets_threshold = yes
            oe_heg_ai_cand_score_diff > 0
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_best_score value = oe_heg_ai_cand_score }
        oe_heg_ai_record_this = yes
    }
}

# Any/Country scope: clear all cached anti-hegemon globals cleanly.
oe_heg_ai_clear_cache = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_active value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_theater value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_size value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_ent_high value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_tag_id value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_best_score value = 0 }
    remove_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target
}

# Any/Country scope: run the fixed O(1) 22-tag roster + caller scan.
oe_heg_ai_rescan_now = {
    oe_heg_ai_clear_cache = yes
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ } c:BYZ = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ROM } c:ROM = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GLH } c:GLH = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MOS } c:MOS = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:RUS } c:RUS = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:FRA } c:FRA = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HAB } c:HAB = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CAS } c:CAS = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SPA } c:SPA = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MAM } c:MAM = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:POL } c:POL = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PLC } c:PLC = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TIM } c:TIM = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:IRA } c:IRA = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:DLH } c:DLH = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VIJ } c:VIJ = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ENG } c:ENG = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GBR } c:GBR = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MUG } c:MUG = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BAH } c:BAH = { oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes } }
    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no is_subject = no }
        oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_active value = 1 }
    }
}

# Scheduler Slot 67 entry point (deduplicated once per calendar month via global_var:oe_heg_ai_ran_m).
# Safe to call from both gen_mainline_lock.py (BYZ scope) and oe_heg_ai_pulse.txt fallback.
oe_heg_ai_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { global_var:oe_heg_ai_ran_m ?= oe_heg_ai_m_now }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_ran_m value = oe_heg_ai_m_now }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_off = yes }
            oe_heg_ai_clear_cache = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_heg_ai_test_force ?= 1 }
            # Preserve active dev-test simulation until cleared by hegclr.
        }
        else = {
            oe_heg_ai_rescan_now = yes
        }
    }
}

# ---- TEST ONLY helpers (called by DEV_LINES heg* on Page 66; zero debug_log!)
oe_heg_ai_test_tick = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_ran_m
    oe_heg_ai_monthly = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg_ai.90
}

oe_heg_ai_test_sim_t1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_test_force value = 1 }
    oe_heg_ai_record_this = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_active value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_theater value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_ent_high value = 0 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg_ai.90
}

oe_heg_ai_test_sim_t2 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_test_force value = 1 }
    oe_heg_ai_record_this = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_active value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_theater value = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_ent_high value = 0 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg_ai.90
}

oe_heg_ai_test_sim_t3 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_test_force value = 1 }
    oe_heg_ai_record_this = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_active value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_theater value = 3 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_ent_high value = 0 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg_ai.90
}

oe_heg_ai_test_ent_high = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_test_force value = 1 }
        oe_heg_ai_record_this = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_active value = 1 }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_ent_high value = 1 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg_ai.90
}

oe_heg_ai_test_ent_low = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_ent_high value = 0 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg_ai.90
}

oe_heg_ai_test_clear = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_test_force
    remove_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_ran_m
    oe_heg_ai_monthly = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg_ai.90
}
